sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: Here's a question we get asked all the time.
sentences.zh: 我们经常被问到一个问题。

sentences.en: How do you change someone's behavior?
sentences.zh: 你该如何改变一个人的行为？

sentences.en: How awesome would it be if you, the victim, decided to not get upset?
sentences.zh: 如果你作为受害者，决定不为此感到难过，那该有多好？

sentences.en: Experts trying to change the way we live our lives.
sentences.zh: 专家们试图改变我们生活的方式。

sentences.en: The biggest single cause of global warming, along with deforestation, which is 20% of it,
sentences.zh: 全球变暖的单一最大成因，连同占20%比例的森林砍伐，

sentences.en: is the burning of fossil fuels.
Oil is a problem and coal is the most serious problem.
sentences.zh: 石油是个问题，而煤炭则是最严重的问题。

sentences.en: Presidents trying to reshape our culture.
sentences.zh: 总统们试图重塑我们的文化。

sentences.en: For we have a choice in this country.
sentences.zh: 因为在这个国家，我们有选择的权利。

sentences.en: We can accept a politics that breeds division,
sentences.zh: 我们可以接受一种滋生分裂的政治，

sentences.en: or we can come together and say, not this time.
sentences.zh: 或者我们可以团结起来说：这次不行。

sentences.en: We like to think we change people's behavior through information,
sentences.zh: 我们倾向于认为可以通过信息、
教育和说服来改变人们的行为。

sentences.en: Now, these things often don't work,
sentences.zh: 然而，这些方法往往并不奏效，

sentences.en: but we keep doing them because we have an unshakable faith
sentences.zh: 但我们仍坚持这样做，因为我们对人性有一个根深蒂固的假设，

sentences.en: in a core assumption about human nature.
If you want to shape how people behave,
sentences.zh: 如果你想塑造人们的行为，

sentences.en: you must first change the way they think.
sentences.zh: 你必须首先改变他们的思维方式。

sentences.en: Today, we look at a very different approach,
sentences.zh: 今天，我们来看看一种截然不同的方法，

sentences.en: one that will take us on a journey from the outskirts of Budapest in 1944
sentences.zh: 它将带我们踏上一段旅程，从1944年布达佩斯的郊区，

sentences.en: to the hills of Rwanda a half-century later.
sentences.zh: 一直到半个世纪后的卢旺达山丘。

sentences.en: how to change behavior, it's not what you think.
sentences.zh: 关于如何改变行为，这与你想象的并不一样。

sentences.en: When Erwin Staub was a small child, his family had a live-in caretaker named Maria Gogan.
sentences.zh: 欧文·斯托布小时候，家里有一位住家保姆，名叫玛丽亚·戈根。

sentences.en: Erwin had his own name for her.
sentences.zh: 欧文有他自己对她的称呼。

sentences.en: We called her Much, which is an abbreviation of the Hungarian word Muchka, which means cat.
sentences.zh: 我们叫她“猫”，这是匈牙利语“Muchka”的缩写，意思是猫。

sentences.en: That's because Much told Erwin and his sister bedtime stories,
sentences.zh: 那是因为“猫”会给欧文和他姐姐讲睡前故事，

sentences.en: and sometimes, as she told these stories,
sentences.zh: 有时，当她讲这些故事时，

sentences.en: she'd curl up at the foot of the bed and fall asleep.
Outside that cozy house, things were very different.
sentences.zh: 在那间舒适的房子外面，情况却大不相同。
欧文面对的是一个危险的世界。

sentences.en: You see, Erwin was not just a six-year-old child, but...
sentences.zh: 要知道，欧文当时不仅是一个六岁的孩子，而且……

sentences.en: A six-year-old Jewish child, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，是一个六岁的犹太孩子。

sentences.en: Hungary was not a friendly place to be Jewish.
sentences.zh: 匈牙利并不是一个对犹太人友好的地方。

sentences.en: Since the 1920s, the Hungarian government had passed a series of anti-Jewish laws
sentences.zh: 自20世纪20年代以来，匈牙利政府通过了一系列反犹法律，
限制犹太人从事某些职业，

sentences.en: stripping them of the right to vote,
When World War II erupted, Erwin and his family were in grave danger.
sentences.zh: 当第二次世界大战爆发时，欧文和他的家人处于极度危险之中。
欧文记得和“猫”一起散步，

sentences.en: pushing his little sister down the street in a baby carriage.
sentences.zh: 推着婴儿车里的妹妹走在街上。

sentences.en: He heard a massive rumbling and turned to see German tanks rolling down the street.
sentences.zh: 他听到一阵巨大的轰鸣声，转头看到德国坦克正滚滚驶过街道。

sentences.en: With the help of hundreds of thousands of Hungarian citizens,
sentences.zh: 在成千上万匈牙利公民的帮助下，

sentences.en: they rounded up the country's Jews.
sentences.zh: 他们搜捕了该国的犹太人。

sentences.en: As nearly half a million people were dragged off to places like Auschwitz,
sentences.zh: 当近五十万人被拖往奥斯威辛等地时，

sentences.en: most Hungarians did nothing to help.
sentences.zh: 大多数匈牙利人并没有提供任何帮助。

sentences.en: They simply watched as their friends and neighbors disappeared.
sentences.zh: 他们只是眼睁睁地看着自己的朋友和邻居消失。

sentences.en: Young Irwin might have faced the same fate,
sentences.zh: 年幼的欧文可能也会面临同样的命运，
但有人介入提供了帮助。
那就是玛丽亚，也就是“猫”。

sentences.en: She took my sister and me into hiding with a Christian family.
sentences.zh: 她带着我和姐姐躲进了一个基督徒家庭。

sentences.en: To feed the children and their mother,
sentences.zh: 为了给孩子们和他们的母亲提供食物，

sentences.en: Much would carry large amounts of dough and the baby carriage to the bakery,
sentences.zh: “猫”会带着大量的面团和婴儿车去面包店，

sentences.en: and then come back with freshly baked loaves.
sentences.zh: 然后带着刚烤好的面包回来。

sentences.en: But one day, Hungarian Nazis saw all the bread that she was carrying,
sentences.zh: 但有一天，匈牙利纳粹看到了她携带的所有面包，

sentences.en: They told her that if she's going to help Jews, she will be killed.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉她，如果她要帮助犹太人，她就会被杀掉。

sentences.en: Had her stand at the wall with her hands up for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 让她面朝墙壁举着手站了很长时间。

sentences.en: Eventually, a man from the neighborhood, a well-respected Hungarian Nazi,
sentences.zh: 最终，邻居里的一名男子，一位受人尊敬的匈牙利纳粹，

sentences.en: saw what was happening, and he told the others to stop.
sentences.zh: 看到了这一幕，他叫其他人停手。

sentences.en: One might think that after such a terrifying experience,
sentences.zh: 人们可能会认为，经历了如此恐怖的遭遇，

sentences.en: March might have stopped helping the Staub family.
sentences.zh: “猫”可能就不会再帮助斯托布一家了。

sentences.en: And she continued to do the same thing for the rest of the time.
sentences.zh: 并且在接下来的时间里，她继续做着同样的事情。

sentences.en: March also found out where Irwin's father was being held in a forced labor camp.
sentences.zh: “猫”还打听到了欧文的父亲被关押在哪个强迫劳动营。

sentences.en: She went there and approached the wire fencing.
sentences.zh: 她去了那里，走近铁丝网围栏。

sentences.en: She asked someone to summon Irwin's dad.
sentences.zh: 她请人叫出欧文的父亲。

sentences.en: Through the fence, she told him where she had taken the children.
sentences.zh: 隔着围栏，她告诉他她把孩子们藏在了哪里。

sentences.en: So when the whole group from this forced labor camp was taken to Germany,
sentences.zh: 所以当这个强迫劳动营的整群人被带往德国时，

sentences.en: they had a stopover in BudapeSt.
sentences.zh: 他们在布达佩斯中转停留。

sentences.en: And during that stopover, my father escaped.
sentences.zh: 在那次停留期间，我父亲逃脱了。

sentences.en: His father found the house with Irwin and his sister.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲找到了欧文和姐姐藏身的房子。

sentences.en: They all hid together and managed to survive the war.
sentences.zh: 他们全家躲在一起，设法在战争中幸存了下来。

sentences.en: Irwin is very sure that March saved his life and the lives of his immediate family.
sentences.zh: 欧文非常确信是“猫”救了他和他直系亲属的命。

sentences.en: Other relatives, who didn't have someone like March to help them, perished.
sentences.zh: 其他没有像“猫”这样的人帮助的亲戚，都遇难了。

sentences.en: My father's sister and her two children were killed in Auschwitz.
sentences.zh: 我父亲的姐姐和她的两个孩子在奥斯威辛被杀害了。

sentences.en: My mother's sister's husband, my uncle, died in a forced labor camp.
sentences.zh: 我母亲的姐妹的丈夫，也就是我的叔叔，死在了强迫劳动营。

sentences.en: As Irwin grew up, he found himself dwelling on the question.
sentences.zh: 随着欧文长大，他发现自己一直在思考一个问题。

sentences.en: Why do people do terrible things to one another?
sentences.zh: 为什么人们会互相残杀？

sentences.en: And is it possible to stop them?
Irwin eventually got a PhD in psychology from Stanford
sentences.zh: 欧文最终在斯坦福大学获得了心理学博士学位，

sentences.en: and taught clinical psychology at Harvard University.
sentences.zh: 并在哈佛大学教授临床心理学。

sentences.en: All the while, he kept researching how the Nazis dehumanized the Jews
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他一直在研究纳粹是如何将犹太人非人化，

sentences.en: as a stepping stone to genocide.
sentences.zh: 并以此作为种族灭绝的垫脚石。

sentences.en: He studied the factors that led to Hitler's rise and Nazi ideology.
sentences.zh: 他研究了导致希特勒崛起和纳粹意识形态的因素。

sentences.en: Evil leaders can get people riled up,
sentences.zh: 邪恶的领导人可以煽动民众，

sentences.en: but the spark of hate usually doesn't turn into a fire
sentences.zh: 但仇恨的火花通常不会演变成大火，

sentences.en: unless people are also experiencing difficult life conditions.
sentences.zh: 除非人们同时也处于艰难的生活境遇中。

sentences.en: So if Germany had not been in the terrible state that it was in,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果德国当时没有处于那种糟糕的状态，

sentences.en: losing a war, a revolution, people in groups fighting on the streets for years,
sentences.zh: 战败、革命、人们在街头混战多年，

sentences.en: a tremendous depression, if Germany hadn't had that,
sentences.zh: 巨大的经济萧条，如果德国没有这些，

sentences.en: combined with a history of devaluation of Jews,
sentences.zh: 再加上贬低犹太人的历史，

sentences.en: then it is unlikely that Hitler would have been heard.
sentences.zh: 那么希特勒不太可能被人们倾听。

sentences.en: It's unlikely that Hitler's maniacal, intense, but charismatic capacity
sentences.zh: 希特勒那种疯狂、强烈但又充满魅力的能力，

sentences.en: to talk to people would have had the kind of effects that it did.
sentences.zh: 去影响人们，也不太可能产生那样的效果。

sentences.en: So, yes, evil people are important, but not alone.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，邪恶的人很重要，但并非孤立存在。

sentences.en: Bad leaders don't alone create it.
sentences.zh: 坏的领导人并不能独自造成这一切。

sentences.en: Irwin developed a theory of how genocide comes about.
sentences.zh: 欧文发展出了一套关于种族灭绝如何产生的理论。

sentences.en: As leaders spread hateful ideologies and as people get used to ostracizing others,
sentences.zh: 当领导人传播仇恨意识形态，当人们习惯于排斥他人时，

sentences.en: hostility between groups slowly evolves into violence.
sentences.zh: 群体间的敌意会慢慢演变成暴力。

sentences.en: Irwin came up with a term for this gradual process,
sentences.zh: 欧文为这个渐进的过程起了一个术语，

sentences.en: There is experimental research that shows
that when a person engages in a violent action,
sentences.zh: 当一个人参与了暴力行为，

sentences.en: they are likely to engage in more and greater violence.
sentences.zh: 他们很可能会参与更多、更严重的暴力。

sentences.en: In studying a variety of genocide and mass killings,
sentences.zh: 在研究了各种种族灭绝和大规模屠杀后，

sentences.en: I saw this in every case,
sentences.zh: 我在每一个案例中都看到了这一点，

sentences.en: devaluation is justified in terms of the ideology,
sentences.zh: 贬低行为在意识形态层面得到了辩护，

sentences.en: that these people stand in the way of us creating this better world.
sentences.zh: 认为这些人阻碍了我们创造更美好的世界。

sentences.en: So, this is very important to understand
sentences.zh: 所以，理解这一点非常重要，

sentences.en: and very important to try to counteract.
sentences.zh: 尝试去抵制它也非常重要。

sentences.en: Irwin tried to imagine what might have stopped this march to violence.
sentences.zh: 欧文试图想象是什么可能阻止了这场走向暴力的行径。

sentences.en: he knew that active bystanders can have a huge impact
sentences.zh: 他知道积极的旁观者可以在拯救受害者生命方面，

sentences.en: in saving the lives of victiMs.
why do some bystanders choose to intervene
sentences.zh: 为什么有些旁观者选择介入，

sentences.en: while so many others stay silent?
Why had March taken such great risks
sentences.zh: 为什么“猫”要冒那么大的风险，

sentences.en: to save Irwin and his family?
sentences.zh: 去拯救欧文和他的家人？

sentences.en: I think she did it because she loved us,
sentences.zh: 我想她这样做是因为她爱我们，

sentences.en: because she was connected to us,
because she saw us as human beings
sentences.zh: 因为她把我们视为人类，

sentences.en: and didn't accept and go along with the devaluation of Jews
sentences.zh: 并且不接受也不随波逐流地去贬低犹太人，

sentences.en: that was part of the society at that time.
sentences.zh: 那是当时社会的一部分。

sentences.en: Closed personal relationships between Jews and Christians
sentences.zh: 犹太人和基督徒之间亲密的个人关系，

sentences.en: could inoculate people against stereotypes and prejudice.
sentences.zh: 可以使人们免受刻板印象和偏见的影响。

sentences.en: The close relationship that March had had with him and his family
sentences.zh: “猫”与他和他的家人之间亲密的关系，

sentences.en: made it possible for her to see Jews as human beings
sentences.zh: 使她能够将犹太人视为值得保护的、

sentences.en: she was sent out to work as a servant in other families.
sentences.zh: 她就被送出去在其他家庭做佣人。

sentences.en: And she made very good connections to children,
sentences.zh: 她与孩子们建立了很好的联系，

sentences.en: and I think to the people she worked for.
sentences.zh: 我想也包括她为之工作的人们。

sentences.en: And she received a lot of love and care
sentences.zh: 她从这些孩子那里得到了很多爱和关怀，

sentences.en: from these children back in return for her love.
sentences.zh: 作为对她付出的爱的回报。

sentences.en: That was a very important healing experience on her part.
sentences.zh: 这对她来说是一次非常重要的治愈经历。

sentences.en: So all of these things, I think,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，所有这些事情，

sentences.en: contributed to the kind of person she became
sentences.zh: 都促成了她成为那样的人，

sentences.en: and her openness and readiness to be altruistic.
sentences.zh: 以及她那种利他主义的开放性和准备。

sentences.en: Irwin felt that his personal experiences
sentences.zh: 欧文觉得他的个人经历，

sentences.en: provided a roadmap to combat hatred.
sentences.zh: 为对抗仇恨提供了一份路线图。

sentences.en: He started to think about how to inoculate people
sentences.zh: 他开始思考如何为人们接种疫苗，
以抵御仇恨言论和不宽容。

sentences.en: sharing his ideas at academic conferences.
sentences.zh: 在学术会议上分享他的观点。

sentences.en: He became a renowned expert on the causes of genocide.
sentences.zh: 他成为了种族灭绝成因方面的知名专家。

sentences.en: You know, when this process begins,
sentences.zh: 你知道，当这个过程开始时，

sentences.en: when a society begins to harm some group
sentences.zh: 当一个社会开始伤害某个群体，

sentences.en: and devalues it more and justifies it
sentences.zh: 并对其进行贬低和合理化，

sentences.en: the only thing that can stop it

sentences.zh: 那些看到正在发生什么，

sentences.en: and who begin to take action against it.
sentences.zh: 开始采取行动抵制它的人。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, much of the time,
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，在大多数情况下，

sentences.en: on a whole scale, this doesn't happen.
sentences.zh: 从整体规模来看，这种情况并没有发生。

sentences.en: But there are wonderful instances when it does.
sentences.zh: 但也有一些美好的例子确实发生了。

sentences.en: And there are many examples of even single individuals
doing things that changes the course of a society.
sentences.zh: 做出的事情改变了一个社会的进程。

sentences.en: Fifty years after March saved Irwin's life,
sentences.zh: 在马奇救了欧文性命的五十年后，

sentences.en: he began hearing about an unfolding disaster
sentences.zh: 他开始听到东非国家卢旺达，

sentences.en: in the East African country of Rwanda.
A radio station was broadcasting urgent messages
sentences.zh: 一家广播电台正在向七百万人口，

sentences.en: to the population of seven million.
Very few recordings of these broadcasts exist today.
sentences.zh: 如今这些广播的录音存世极少。

sentences.en: Rwanda belongs to those who truly defend it.
sentences.zh: 卢旺达属于那些真正捍卫它的人。

sentences.en: And you, the cockroaches, are not Rwandans.
sentences.zh: 而你们，这些蟑螂，不是卢旺达人。
让我们欢呼吧，我的朋友们。

sentences.en: Just as the Nazis portrayed Jews as subhuman,
sentences.zh: 正如纳粹将犹太人描绘成非人类一样，

sentences.en: the Rwandan government, dominated by the Hutu group,
sentences.zh: 由胡图族主导的卢旺达政府，
也将图西族少数群体非人化。
他们选择的武器是什么？

sentences.en: Or as some call it, hate radio.
sentences.zh: 或者正如有些人所称的，仇恨广播。

sentences.en: The broadcasts had a real effect.
sentences.zh: 这些广播产生了真实的影响。

sentences.en: One Harvard study calculated that hate radio
sentences.zh: 哈佛大学的一项研究计算出，仇恨广播，

sentences.en: Killers often carried a machete in one hand
sentences.zh: 杀手们通常一手拿着砍刀，

sentences.en: and a transistor radio in the other.
sentences.zh: 另一手拿着晶体管收音机。

sentences.en: As the French historian Jean-Pierre Chrétien put it,
sentences.zh: 正如法国历史学家让-皮埃尔·克雷蒂安所言，

sentences.en: the first to give and receive orders,
sentences.zh: 前者用来下达和接收命令，

sentences.en: I had to move by night,
you know, fleeing through bushes and whatever.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在灌木丛中逃亡之类的。

sentences.en: During the genocide, Andre lived in Kigali,
sentences.zh: 种族灭绝期间，安德烈住在卢旺达首都，

sentences.en: He talked to us on Skype from Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 他通过Skype在卢旺达与我们交谈。

sentences.en: He told me armed men came to his house
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，武装人员来到他家，
把所有人都拖到了外面。
我记得在种族灭绝期间，

sentences.en: I don't know how they came.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们是怎么来的。

sentences.en: We had closed the doors and the curtains were put on.
sentences.zh: 我们关上了门，拉上了窗帘。

sentences.en: Andre fully expected to be killed.
sentences.zh: 安德烈完全以为自己会被杀掉。

sentences.en: I don't know what prevented them from killing us
sentences.zh: 我不知道是什么阻止了他们杀害我们，

sentences.en: because they were having these, you know,
sentences.zh: 因为他们拿着这些，你知道，

sentences.en: traditional weapons and whatever and whatever.
sentences.zh: 传统的武器之类的东西。

sentences.en: I asked Andre how many people came to his house with machetes.
sentences.zh: 我问安德烈有多少人拿着砍刀来到他家。

sentences.en: He had a hard time answering.
I couldn't even look at them straight in the eyes.
sentences.zh: 我甚至无法直视他们的眼睛。

sentences.en: It's like they didn't want, you know,
sentences.zh: 就好像他们不想，你知道，

sentences.en: So they were saying, lay down and whatever.
sentences.zh: 所以他们一直在说，趴下之类的。

sentences.en: Upheaval in the African state of Rwanda.
